title: calliandra haematomma
intro: Calliandra haematomma, commonly known as the Red Powder Puff, is a flowering plant native to tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include treating fever, diarrhea, and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Calliandra haematomma include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, making it effective in wound healing and infection prevention. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
